title: $1,000 IN 2010
subtitle: WHERE IT IS NOW - 2026
outro:
Follow for the money
nobody explains.
vo: Picture this. It's twenty ten, and you have one thousand dollars. Put it in the S and P five hundred, and today you'd have around three thousand. Apple would turn it into twenty thousand. Netflix, forty five thousand. But if you had put that same thousand dollars into Nvidia, the chip maker behind the AI boom, you would be sitting on nearly two hundred thousand dollars today. One choice. A hundred times the difference. Which one did you pick? Follow, for the money nobody explains.
